KIKI - 60% OFF!

A vibrant platformer with unique graphics and catchy chiptune soundtrack! Dodge treacherous traps and obstacles, overcome only by your agility and quick reflexes. Don’t miss the chance to test your abilities and become a true master of jumping! 🏃‍♀️

Spellagis is an arena-shooter and roguelite hybrid. Brave mages unite to prevent darkness and restore balance. By combining knowledge and artifacts, they engage in a battle where every step towards victory is deceptive and dangerous.

Knight's Night! — is a retro-style 1-bit platformer. Collect items, unlock new abilities, and make your way into the evil wizard's castle to save the kingdom!

notes.title: The Red Exile — Release is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41207362/4d608f9f0fb35fa0465e36003f9e139a88be69e5.png

Hello everyone!

We have been walking towards this day for several months, and today it has arrived. The Red Exile is ready to leave early access and move into the status of a released game. Hooray!

Changelog:

 Added hands and animations for all items.
 NipoCola was removed and a syringe added in its place.
 Changed the lighting in the rooms.
 Some perks have been seriously reworked.
 New room with an altar.
 We have replaced searching chests for the appearance of items on the shelves.
 And many, many more inconspicuous details that increase the pleasure of the game.

Future plans:

 Localization.
 Fixes.
 Linux and MacOS builds.
 And one secret news.

Cheers,
NipoBox Team

notes.title: The Red Exile Update 0.851
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have listened carefully to your wishes, and are ready to present you update version 0.851!

Changelog:

 Added a marker that indicates the location of the Altar
 The Chase stage is now accompanied by a heartbeat sound
 Reduced number of generated rooms by 50%
 The efficiency of the energy drink has been increased
 Now the Killer cannot start the chase immediately after the start of the session. The chase will start some time after the start of the game

 Added crouching
 Changed main menu
